_notes.world_type_missions: Maps world type → eligible mission IDs when that node is the committed front. Reclamation (Op 11) is always in the eligible pool regardless of node type — it runs on the Wrath of Espandor void sub-theatre which is accessible from any committed planet. It does not appear in world_type_missions because it is not terrain-gated.
_notes.game_planet: Nodes with game_planet: true are the three in-game map planets. All other nodes use those maps with narrative reskinning — the bot picks geometry from the eligible mission IDs.
_notes.current_position: Tracked in campaign state data file (not here). This graph is static.
_notes.pressure: Per-node pressure tracked in campaign state data file.
_notes.traversal: Each beat, before planet seeds generate, Watch Master picks: hold current node OR move to one adjacent node. Bot reads edges from current position and presents eligible moves filtered by proximity.
